stem:
Students in two groups were asked to guess the number of marbles in a jar. The box plots display each group’s responses.

Number of Marbles in a Jar

Which statement is best supported by the information in the box plots?

options.label: A
options.text: The range of the data for Group 2 is equal to the range of the data for Group 1.

options.label: B
options.text: The distribution of the data for Group 1 is more symmetrical than the distribution of the data for Group 2.

options.label: C
options.text: The interquartile range of the data for Group 1 is greater than the interquartile range of the data for Group 2.

options.label: D
options.text: The median number of the data for Group 1 is greater than the median number of the data for Group 2.

visual_elements: box plots for Group 1 and Group 2 labeled with Number of Marbles in a Jar and horizontal scale from 10 to 36
